rules.rule: One initial Light per PR; later source, metadata, retry and base changes do not require another Light. Exact-head final verification remains mandatory for automatic approval.
rules.source: User2026-11-14: one Light per PR, no subsequent reruns regardless of changes; coordinator authorized persistent workflow and controller correction without disrupting PR05 Full.
rules.initialization: Existing open PRs do not get another Light on synchronize or reopen. Full/Quick can execute exact current checks without a Light artifact. Existing in-flight PR05 remains pinned to its unchanged head.
rules.dateAndPermission: No business dates, production data, server protection or authorization changed. Original Review threads, exact head/base/mode and final receipts remain enforced. Same-head artifact verification remains required only when actually reused.
rules.expectation: Opened attempt1 only; edited/reopened/synchronize and attempt2 allocate no Light. Missing/failed/cancelled/old/running Light does not block an independent complete final. Actual reused stale or missing Light is rejected. Final failures, drift, unresolved Review and API denial still reject.

checks.context: Node22.22.0; local isolated temporary fixtures and mocked GitHub API. Actual workflow expressions and full CI protocol suites. No network writes, deployment or business data modifications.
